summary: Female ultramarathoner in her late 20s lost the trail while descending from the Abyss Lake trailhead in the rain; a SARDOC dog trailed her about 3.5 miles through steep, wet terrain and made the find after 3 hours; the team warmed her and walked her out.
notes: Date Friday-verified. SARDOC mission report: handler scented dog at subject's vehicle ~11 p.m., dog trailed ~3.5 mi and made the find in a meadow.
